#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Underline all headlines in the unpacked quarterly_report.docx document.

Headline identification (from inspection of word/document.xml): the report has
no heading styles; its headlines are the seven all-caps section-title paragraphs:

    EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
    FINANCIAL HIGHLIGHTS
    REVENUE BREAKDOWN BY SEGMENT
    KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS
    OPERATING EXPENSES
    Q1 2025 OUTLOOK
    RISK FACTORS

For each such paragraph, add <w:u w:val="single"/> to the run properties of every
run that carries visible text. Text content is unchanged; only formatting changes.
"""

import os
import sys

BASE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
SKILL_ROOT = os.path.join(BASE, ".codex", "skills", "docx")
sys.path.insert(0, SKILL_ROOT)

from scripts.utilities import XMLEditor  # noqa: E402

W_NS = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main"

HEADLINES = {
    "EXECUTIVE SUMMARY",
    "FINANCIAL HIGHLIGHTS",
    "REVENUE BREAKDOWN BY SEGMENT",
    "KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS",
    "OPERATING EXPENSES",
    "Q1 2025 OUTLOOK",
    "RISK FACTORS",
}


def text_of(container):
    """Concatenate text of all w:t descendants of a DOM container."""
    parts = []
    for t in container.getElementsByTagName("w:t"):
        if t.firstChild is not None and t.firstChild.nodeType == t.TEXT_NODE:
            parts.append(t.firstChild.data)
    return "".join(parts)


def main():
    unpacked_arg = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "unpacked"
    doc_xml = os.path.join(BASE, unpacked_arg, "word", "document.xml")
    if not os.path.isfile(doc_xml):
        raise SystemExit(f"document.xml not found at {doc_xml}")

    editor = XMLEditor(doc_xml)
    dom = editor.dom

    paragraphs = dom.getElementsByTagName("w:p")
    nonempty = {text_of(p).strip() for p in paragraphs if text_of(p).strip()}
    missing = HEADLINES - nonempty
    if missing:
        raise SystemExit(f"Expected headlines not found in document: {sorted(missing)}")

    underlined_paras = []
    for p in paragraphs:
        if text_of(p).strip() not in HEADLINES:
            continue
        for r in p.getElementsByTagName("w:r"):
            if not text_of(r).strip():
                continue  # skip empty runs inside the headline paragraph
            rprs = r.getElementsByTagName("w:rPr")
            if not rprs:
                continue
            rpr = rprs[0]
            if rpr.getElementsByTagName("w:u"):
                continue  # already underlined
            u = dom.createElementNS(W_NS, "w:u")
            u.setAttributeNS(W_NS, "w:val", "single")
            rpr.appendChild(u)
        underlined_paras.append(text_of(p).strip())

    editor.save()

    print("Underlined headlines (%d):" % len(underlined_paras))
    for title in sorted(underlined_paras):
        print("  - " + title)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
